scene_analysis.scene_overview: A rainy day in a park with two people holding umbrellas, surrounded by trees and bushes, with a black fence in the background. The ground is wet and there are leaves scattered all over the place. There are two people standing under an umbrella, one wearing a black jacket and blue jeans, and the other wearing a black jacket and pants. The person in the front has a blue umbrella. The sky is gray and cloudy.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building in the back has a cream-colored facade with stone quoins at the corners. It is tall and narrow. The building in the middle has a red brick facade with a flat roof. It is wider than the other buildings.
scene_analysis.materials: The ground is made of concrete with some yellow leaves scattered all over it. There are also some small rocks and pebbles.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are no benches or tables visible.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are several trees and bushes surrounding the area. Some have yellow leaves, while others have green leaves.
scene_analysis.ground_surfaces: The ground is wet and shiny. There are some puddles of water on the ground.
scene_analysis.spatial_enclosure: The area is enclosed by a black metal fence.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: There are no people walking around.
scene_analysis.lighting_atmosphere: It is raining heavily, but the sky is still visible through the trees.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The area seems quiet and peaceful.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The area is not very popular.
scene_analysis.as_student: The area is not very accessible.
